The iPhone 18 Pro is set to launch next week, and it's expected to bring three upgrades that have been rumored for years. Here's what's new.

#1: Variable Aperture Lens

Since The Information published a detailed report on a 'variable aperture' lens system over two years ago, it has generated a lot of discussion. At the time, the report indicated that the target model for this new feature was the iPhone 17. However, Ming-Chi Kuo stated that this feature would actually appear first in the iPhone 18 series.

Now that the iPhone 18 Pro is about to be unveiled, the latest news suggests that the variable aperture feature will indeed be added to the main camera—at least in the Pro Max model, if not both models.

This new feature is expected to bring some exciting photographic effects, but the actual performance will depend on how Apple implements it. Fortunately, the official launch and full feature reveal are just a few days away.

#2: Smaller Dynamic Island

The iPhone X introduced the 'notch' (瀏海) nearly ten years ago, which was the first cutout area on an iPhone screen. It wasn't until the 2022 iPhone 14 Pro that the current Dynamic Island design was adopted, reducing the size of the cutout.

Four years later, a smaller Dynamic Island is finally making its debut alongside the iPhone 18 Pro.

Rumors indicate that Apple's new Dynamic Island cutout area will be approximately 35% smaller than the previous design. The reduction can actually be seen in the new Siri design in iOS 27.

#3: Apple's In-House C2 Modem Chip

Apple's plan to develop its own modem chip has been an open secret for years. But it wasn't until last year that the first modem chip designed by Apple was launched in an iPhone, namely the C1.

Top comment from EtothaJ

The last thing I read was that the C2 would only be used in foreign versions of the iPhone, while mainland China versions would continue to use Qualcomm. I hope that's not true.

Now there are rumors that Apple plans to drop Qualcomm modems in the iPhone 18 Pro in favor of its own next-generation C2 chip.

The C2 is expected to offer improved speed over the C1X and C1, while retaining the higher efficiency and privacy advantages of each generation of Apple's in-house modem chips.

Which feature of the iPhone 18 Pro are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
